source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of predicting addition polymers (PDF 154).

blocks.text: Jab monomer(s) mein C=C bonds hon to addition polymerisation hoti hai, maslan ethene, propene aur phenylethene (styrene) ke saath. Aam taur par homopolymers, aik qism ke monomer se bane, bante hain, lekin kabhi double bonds wale do mukhtalif monomers ko saath polymerise kar ke copolymer banaya jata hai, jaise ethene aur propenoic acid (CH2=CH-COOH) ka copolymer.

blocks.alt: C=C wale chaar monomers: CH2=CH2 (ethene), CH2=CHCH3 (propene), CH2=CHC6H5 (phenylethene, styrene) aur CH2=CHCOOH (propenoic acid, ethene ke saath copolymer).
blocks.caption: C=C wale monomers jo addition polymerisation karte hain (is lesson ke liye asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.explanation: Do (ya zyada) mukhtalif monomers se bana polymer, maslan ethene aur propenoic acid; homopolymer mein sirf aik qism ka monomer hota hai.

items: C=C monomers: addition polymers (homopolymers ya copolymers).
